description: spillage guard: block prompts with keys, block reading secret files, scrub the transcript at session end

hooks.command: for p in python3 python py; do "$p" -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 9))" 2>/dev/null && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.py" prompt; done
for p in python3 python py; do "$p" -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 9))" 2>/dev/null && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.py" tool; done
for p in python3 python py; do "$p" -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 9))" 2>/dev/null && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.py" session-end; done
